targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS "⚡ Sessions",
  ROUND(SUM((total_energy_added_wh / 1000.0))::numeric, 1) AS "🔋 Total kWh",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cost_decimal > 0 THEN cost_decimal ELSE (total_energy_added_wh / 1000.0) * (SELECT COALESCE(value_num, 0.12) FROM settings WHERE key = 'base_cost_per_kwh') END)::numeric, 2) AS "💰 Total Cost ($)",
  ROUND(AVG((peak_power_w / 1000.0))::numeric, 1) AS "⚡ Avg Power (kW)",
  ROUND(AVG((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at)) / 60.0))::numeric) AS "⏱️ Avg Duration (min)",
  ROUND(AVG(end_soc_pct - start_soc_pct)::numeric) AS "🔋 Avg % Gained"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

SELECT
  cs.id AS "🔗 ID",
  cs.started_at AS "📅 Date",
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.charger_type), '') IS NOT NULL THEN '⚡ ' || cs.charger_type
    WHEN cs.peak_power_w > 20000 THEN '🔌 DC Fast'
    WHEN cs.peak_power_w IS NOT NULL THEN '🏠 AC Level 2'
    ELSE '❔ Unknown'
  END AS "🏷️ Type",
  cs.start_soc_pct AS "🔋 Start",
  cs.end_soc_pct AS "🔋 End",
  cs.delta_soc_pct AS "📈 Gained",
  ROUND((cs.total_energy_added_wh / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "⚡ kWh",
  ROUND((cs.peak_power_w / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "🔌 kW",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.cable_type), ''), '-') AS "🔌 Cable",
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cs.ended_at - cs.started_at)) / 60.0)::numeric) AS "⏱️ Min",
  ROUND(cs.cost_decimal::numeric, 2) AS "💰 Cost",
  NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.cost_currency::text), '') AS "Currency",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.start_place), ''), g.name, 'Unknown') AS "📍 Location"
FROM charging_sessions cs
LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cs.geofence_id
WHERE cs.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  AND $__timeFilter(cs.started_at)
ORDER BY cs.started_at DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(started_at, '1M') AS time,
  SUM((total_energy_added_wh / 1000.0)) AS "Energy (kWh)"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(started_at, '1M') AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cost_decimal > 0 THEN cost_decimal ELSE (total_energy_added_wh / 1000.0) * (SELECT COALESCE(value_num, 0.12) FROM settings WHERE key = 'base_cost_per_kwh') END) AS "Cost ($)"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN charger_type IS NOT NULL AND charger_type != '' THEN charger_type
    WHEN (peak_power_w / 1000.0) > 20 THEN 'DC Fast'
    ELSE 'Home/AC'
  END AS "🏷️ Type",
  COUNT(*) AS "🔄 Sessions"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN charger_type IS NOT NULL AND charger_type != '' THEN charger_type
    WHEN (peak_power_w / 1000.0) > 20 THEN 'DC Fast'
    ELSE 'Home/AC'
  END AS "🏷️ Type",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cost_decimal > 0 THEN cost_decimal ELSE (total_energy_added_wh / 1000.0) * (SELECT COALESCE(value_num, 0.12) FROM settings WHERE key = 'base_cost_per_kwh') END)::numeric, 2) AS "Cost ($)"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH priced AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.start_place), ''), g.name, 'Unknown') AS location,
    cs.total_energy_added_wh AS energy_wh,
    CASE
      WHEN cs.cost_decimal IS NOT NULL
       AND NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.cost_currency::text), '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN cs.cost_decimal
      WHEN rate.rate_per_wh IS NOT NULL
        THEN cs.total_energy_added_wh * rate.rate_per_wh
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cost,
    CASE
      WHEN cs.cost_decimal IS NOT NULL
       AND NULLIF(BTRIM(cs.cost_currency::text), '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN BTRIM(cs.cost_currency::text)
      WHEN rate.rate_per_wh IS NOT NULL THEN rate.currency
      ELSE NULL
    END AS currency
  FROM charging_sessions cs
  LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cs.geofence_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT gr.rate_per_wh, BTRIM(gr.currency::text) AS currency
    FROM geofence_rates gr
    WHERE gr.id = cs.rate_id
       OR (
         gr.geofence_id = cs.geofence_id
         AND cs.started_at >= gr.effective_from
         AND (gr.effective_to IS NULL OR cs.started_at < gr.effective_to)
       )
    ORDER BY (gr.id = cs.rate_id) DESC, gr.effective_from DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) rate ON TRUE
  WHERE cs.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(cs.started_at)
    AND cs.total_energy_added_wh > 0
)
SELECT
  location || ' · ' || currency AS "Location",
  ROUND((SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(energy_wh) / 1000.0, 0))::numeric, 3)
    AS "Cost / kWh"
FROM priced
WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND currency IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY location, currency
ORDER BY "Cost / kWh" DESC

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (peak_power_w / 1000.0) <= 7.7 THEN '🏠 ≤7.7 kW (L2)'
    WHEN (peak_power_w / 1000.0) <= 11.5 THEN '🔌 ≤11.5 kW (L2+)'
    WHEN (peak_power_w / 1000.0) <= 50 THEN '⚡ ≤50 kW (DC)'
    WHEN (peak_power_w / 1000.0) <= 150 THEN '⚡ ≤150 kW (SC v2)'
    ELSE '⚡ 150+ kW (SC v3)'
  END AS "Power Range",
  COUNT(*) AS "🔄 Sessions",
  ROUND(AVG((total_energy_added_wh / 1000.0))::numeric, 1) AS "⚡ Avg kWh"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN((peak_power_w / 1000.0))

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN start_soc_pct < 10 THEN '🔴 0-10%'
    WHEN start_soc_pct < 20 THEN '🟠 10-20%'
    WHEN start_soc_pct < 30 THEN '🟡 20-30%'
    WHEN start_soc_pct < 40 THEN '🟢 30-40%'
    WHEN start_soc_pct < 50 THEN '🟢 40-50%'
    ELSE '🔵 50%+'
  END AS "Start Battery",
  COUNT(*) AS "🔄 Sessions"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(start_soc_pct)

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(started_at, '1M') AS time,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN cost_decimal > 0 THEN cost_decimal ELSE (total_energy_added_wh / 1000.0) * (SELECT COALESCE(value_num, 0.12) FROM settings WHERE key = 'base_cost_per_kwh') END) / NULLIF(SUM((total_energy_added_wh / 1000.0)), 0))::numeric, 3) AS "$/kWh"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id} AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  g.name AS "Location",
  ROUND((gr.rate_per_wh * 1000.0)::numeric, 4) AS "Rate / kWh",
  BTRIM(gr.currency::text) AS "Currency",
  gr.effective_from AS "Effective From",
  gr.effective_to AS "Effective To"
FROM geofence_rates gr
JOIN geofences g ON g.id = gr.geofence_id
ORDER BY g.name, gr.effective_from DESC

SELECT
  ROUND((MAX(peak_power_w) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "🔌 Peak Power (kW)",
  ROUND((AVG(total_energy_added_wh) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1)
    AS "⚡ Avg Session Energy (kWh)",
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at)) / 60.0)::numeric, 0)
    AS "⏱️ Avg Session (min)"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
